Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
Echo of Harmonies [BL:R2]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Melpominee/Presence
Only usable during a referendum.
[pre] If you burn the Edge for a vote, this vampire gains two
additional votes.
[mel] Usable by a ready vampire other than the acting minion. This
vampire gains two votes.
[MEL] Usable by ready vampire other than the acting minion. Move the
political action card <played> to call the referendum from your ash
heap to this vampire at the end of the action. This vampire may burn
that card to call the referendum as a +1 stealth political action [if
he or she meets the requirements of that card].

does the added "<played>" in the online card text mean that the old
ruling allowing Echo to be played at [MEL] on a PA card you just
burned that you previously used Echo at [MEL] on is no longer
applicable, as the PA is burned rather than _played_?

Thanks,

salem
domain:canberra http://www.geocities.com/salem_christ.geo/vtes.htm

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. It's means that you cannot grab a Rumors of Gehenna
if you call a referendum to burn it from play.

The angle brackets mean that it is a clarification, not a change.
